scope: Compact official-source candidate pack for additional Belfast architecture-related planning records from 2008-01-01 through 2026-05-19. Search stopped on user request; retained candidates are high-confidence official Belfast City Council planning committee records that were duplicate-checked by planning reference against the existing Belfast atlas files, previous Belfast subagent packs through round118, and data/manual_drops/architecture_milestones/architecture_milestones_2008_2026.json.

source_audits.source_name: Belfast City Council Planning Committee agendas, minutes and supporting documents
source_audits.source_type: official local authority planning committee agendas, minutes and public reports
source_audits.license_or_terms_note: Belfast City Council public committee pages and PDFs are subject to Belfast City Council website copyright/terms. This pack stores factual metadata, short paraphrases and source URLs only; do not republish report/PDF text without reuse review.
source_audits.coverage_note: Targeted 2020-2026 Planning Committee meeting pages and supporting PDF links, with emphasis on major architecture, housing, student accommodation, civic, school, health, research, public realm and heritage-adjacent planning decisions.
source_audits.reliability: Strong for meeting date, application reference, proposal description and committee action as recorded in official minutes.
source_audits.date_caveats: Committee approval/refusal dates are administrative planning dates. They are not evidence of construction start, completion, occupation, opening, funding certainty, or realised public outcomes.
source_audits.geometry_caveats: Committee records usually provide site addresses but not reusable surveyed coordinates. Candidate coordinates are approximate site or street points from manual/Nominatim lookup and should be replaced by Planning Portal easting/northing or red-line geometry before production import.
source_audits.ingestion_recommendation: Use as documented planning-decision or reserved-matters milestones, visually distinct from built/completed events.

source_audits.source_name: Belfast City Council agenda item minute pages
source_audits.license_or_terms_note: Belfast City Council copyright/terms apply. Store only factual metadata and URLs unless permissions are reviewed.
source_audits.coverage_note: Used where the meeting page truncated the minute text and the agenda item page exposed the final motion, vote, approval, refusal or reserved-matters wording.
source_audits.reliability: Strong for item-specific committee action and supporting-document links.
source_audits.date_caveats: Agenda item dates are meeting dates, not final decision-notice issue dates unless the page explicitly states otherwise.
source_audits.geometry_caveats: No geometry beyond site address; approximate coordinates added only for candidate triage.
source_audits.ingestion_recommendation: Keep agenda item URL as primary committee evidence; reconcile against NI Planning Portal before final import.

source_audits.source_name: Northern Ireland Planning Portal public register
source_audits.publisher: Department for Infrastructure and Northern Ireland planning authorities / Planning Portal
source_audits.license_or_terms_note: Planning Portal content is subject to portal terms and copyright restrictions. Use factual identifiers and link users to the portal rather than reproducing documents.
source_audits.coverage_note: Identified as the follow-up source for final application metadata, decision notice dates, easting/northing and document indexes. Bulk dynamic-page extraction was not continued after the user requested a compact immediate output.
source_audits.reliability: Strong for application-register metadata when records are looked up directly.
source_audits.date_caveats: Portal dates may include received, valid, advertised, decided, appeal or document dates. Do not treat them as construction or occupation dates.
source_audits.geometry_caveats: Portal map points are register points, not surveyed building footprints unless a document/red-line boundary is reviewed.
source_audits.ingestion_recommendation: Use in the next pass to replace approximate coordinates and confirm exact decision-issued dates.

source_audits.source_name: Department for Infrastructure strategic planning, called-in and advertised applications
source_audits.source_type: official department planning adverts and strategic/called-in application pages
source_audits.license_or_terms_note: DfI pages are generally Crown copyright/Open Government Licence subject to exclusions including logos, mapping, personal data and third-party rights.
source_audits.coverage_note: Checked for Belfast regionally significant or called-in planning records. High-signal Belfast items found in this short pass were already in the existing corpus or prior rounds.
source_audits.reliability: Strong for DfI advertised/called-in process records and ministerial decision notices.
source_audits.date_caveats: DfI advertisement, call-in or decision dates are planning-process dates, not physical change dates.
source_audits.geometry_caveats: DfI pages often provide broad site descriptions rather than coordinates.
source_audits.ingestion_recommendation: No new retained candidate from this immediate pass; keep for future duplicate-aware DfI search.
